allowed_root_cause_classes: 4. Ranking lets broad context dominate news-intent context despite available local news
6. Source pack assembly drops or misclassifies retrieved local news
not_root_causes: No A2M-only alias was needed or added.
Canonical SQLite projection remains absent and is reported honestly.
primary_root_cause: Qdrant-backed local news existed for multiple tickers, but ticker-filter parity omitted primary_ticker, candidate breadth/ranking favored broad roundup linked articles, and Cockpit source assembly projected successful local-news hits as context_only rather than claim_verified local_news_context.

safe_fix.ranking: Add primary_ticker filter parity, widen ticker-scoped Qdrant candidates, boost primary/stored ticker/title matches, penalize broad roundup/large-linked baskets, and prefer candidate-relative recency.
safe_fix.source_pack: Only successful direct news/search_news hits become claim_verified local_news_context; context_only, no-hit, data_insufficient, degraded, and missing-required evidence remain unverified.
